description_en: Creates an advanced event query history record. You can save custom query conditional statements for reuse and management
description_zh: 本接口用于创建高级查询历史记录，支持保存自定义查询条件语句以供复用和管理
name: CreateAdvancedQueryHistory

parameters.help_en:
The query conditional statement.

You can edit the query statement based on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2557373.html
parameters.help_zh:
查询条件语句。

您可以根据https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2557373.html编辑查询语句
parameters.name: query_sql

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the simple query mode
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启简单查询模式
parameters.name: simple_query

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. If this parameter is set to true, the system only checks the access link required for creating the query history record without actually creating it. If this parameter is set to false or is not specified, the query history record is created. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否只进行预检查。取值为 true 时仅检查创建查询历史所需的访问链路，不创建查询历史记录；取值为 false 或不传时正常创建查询历史记录。默认值为 false
parameters.name: dry_run
